questions.question: What will happen to the mountain of the house of the LORD in the latter days?
options: It shall be utterly torn down and left in ruins for the wild beasts to roam
It shall be wholly forgotten by all of the many peoples of the wide earth
It shall be hidden far away from the searching eyes of all the proud
It shall be established as the highest, and all nations shall flow to it
questions.answer: It shall be established as the highest, and all nations shall flow to it

questions.question: What famous image of peace appears in Isaiah 2?
options: Building up very high walls and great gates made all of bronze
Beating swords into plowshares and spears into pruning hooks
Forging the plowshares back into sharp swords for the coming war
Raising up great and mighty armies among all of the nations
questions.answer: Beating swords into plowshares and spears into pruning hooks

questions.question: Isaiah 2 says the proud and lofty will be humbled, and the LORD alone exalted.
They shall beat their swords into _____, and their spears into pruning hooks.
Come, let us walk in the _____ of the LORD.
